glos.opis_voice_design_en: Young Polish man, late twenties, enthusiastic apprentice lawyer, a little awkward and endearing. Bright tenor-baritone with a smile in the voice, slightly breathy. Talks like a real person in an office: fast bursts, filler hesitations, cautious half-whisper when he proposes something cheeky, then hopeful upward lift. Native Polish, no foreign accent, no radio voice. Natural room tone of a quiet office, close mic.
